tasks.Calculate_Digit_Permutations: Calculating the number of permutations for two different digits from 0 to 9.
tasks.Calculate_Letter_Permutations: Calculating the number of permutations for two different letters from A to Z.
tasks.Total_Plate_Calculations: Multiplying the results from Calculate_Letter_Permutations and Calculate_Digit_Permutations to get the total number of license plates.
